Class RouteAssembly.ServerFilters

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.RouteAssembly.ServerFilters
Enclosing class:
RouteAssembly
@Internal public final class RouteAssembly.ServerFilters extends Object
A server filter declared in code, like a @ServerFilter bean: its request and response filters are filter routes with its patterns, methods and order.
